items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: Oh yes, yes indeed. He was the nicest boss. He really was. He was just one of the band members.

ctx.x: I mean, that's the biggest thing with a band when it's making history. Very exciting, isn't it. And the guys, I mean, they're fond of Basie, aren't they?
Oh yes, yes indeed. He was the nicest boss. He really was. He was just one of the band members.
